name: Vector Quantization for Volumetric Radiance Fields
definition: A compression strategy that encodes voxel color features into a compact codebook of size K, substituting multiple voxel features with a single code vector to reduce storage from individual voxel storage to codebook storage plus mapping indices.
summary: Vector Quantization for Volumetric Radiance Fields compresses volumetric models by encoding voxel features into a compact codebook, achieving approximately 1 MB storage footprints.
